definitions.lsq_speed_xy_mps: Original radar analyzer NumPy sum-reduction LSQ norm_xy, same bytes/bins; collector einsum velocity separately exact-checked against D_h, old observable magnitude uses frozen tolerance

bins: left closed, right open; all seven always reported
population: owner<0 AND original future valid; no_radar prespecified focus; all/radar_present/no_radar all reported
denominator: ALL original valid objects per horizon/group, including fully covered and photometrically missing objects
point_weight: 1 / number of ALL original points in that object, never renormalized to uncovered/valid/radar subset
full_contribution: sum(weight*benefit)/original object count; positive gain and negative cost separately
harm_reach: each reason cost divided by all-uncovered-group cost, this-radar-group cost and this-radar-speed-bin cost; all use unchanged full denominator

auc.population: exact same reason_code==0 for every feature, actual and broken
auc.zero: excluded only from binary AUC and counted physically

missing: Scores remain undefined; no zero fill. All five reason partitions retain physical support. No new low-texture or depth exclusion.
scene_distribution: each h/radar/GT-group at all speeds: all256 scene rows including null; q25/median/q75 across defined scenes; no CI
paired_difference: AUC_true minus AUC_broken on same valid population; descriptive only, no significance claim
limitations: same source points repeat one image patch/radar cell: not IID
input modalities already influenced D; not statistically independent new sensors
projectable virtual material points are not certified visible surfaces
future LSQ velocity extrapolated to past is an explicit hypothesis
AUC and coverage do not establish useful routing, motion improvement or occupancy improvement
metadata_matrix_tolerance: float64 rtol=0 atol=1e-9; source pose reconstruction and inverse(C)*G0; no metric tolerance change
